name: progress-panel
description: A pane beside every Claude Code chat showing the progress of every session on the machine, grouped by session

progressDir.title: Progress folder
progressDir.description: Folder every session writes its status file to. Empty = progress/ in the Claude config directory (~/.claude/progress). ~/ expands to your home directory.

autoClearDoneHours.title: Auto-clear done tasks after (hours)
autoClearDoneHours.description: Done and skipped tasks older than this are cleared. 0 = never.

keepEndedSessionsDays.title: Keep ended sessions (days)
keepEndedSessionsDays.description: An ended session is removed this many days after it ended. 0 = keep until dismissed.

sortTasksBy.title: Sort tasks by
sortTasksBy.description: The starting order; the pane's Sort button changes it.
